Plan a charging site

Show us where charging could go.

Tell us about your property, your parking and what you want charging to do. We’ll start with the right questions.

Start a conversation

Send us the location, property type and approximate number of parking spaces.

hello@wayline.energy

Useful to include

Who parks there, how long vehicles stay, whether charging is for staff, guests or residents, and when you hope to open the first bays. You do not need a finished electrical design to start the conversation.

What happens next

A first look at the site, then a practical route forward.

We review the parking arrangement and what is known about the electrical supply. A site visit helps establish where charging can go, how many bays the first phase should include and what should be prepared for later. We then put the scope, responsibilities and next decisions in writing.
